chapter_title: 第177章 顏竹笙的獎勵

segments.title: 第177章 顏竹笙的獎勵
segments.content:
Chapter 177 Yan Zhusheng's Reward

"You are like that flame"

"Its blazing fire illuminated me"

Just as Kong Junxiang was singing the chorus again, Ding Xiang's figure had already arrived below the stage.

But because Kong Junxiang was caught up in the excitement of his singing, he lost sight of Ding Xiang again. He didn't notice at all that Ding Xiang had come to the foot of the stage, walked up the side steps, and was now behind him, holding fresh flowers.

At the same time.

Just as Ding Xiang was about to reach out and tap Kong Junxiang's shoulder, Kong Junxiang happened to be singing—

"Although I am happy, I haven't told you"

"I also know that you genuinely like me!"

Right after he sang that, the music entered an interlude.

Kong Junxiang let out a sigh of relief and looked towards Ding Xiang's seat below the stage again, only to find it empty.

This startled him. After confirming that Xu Yinghuan was next to the seat and he hadn't remembered wrong, Kong Junxiang felt an inexplicable sense of disappointment.

But at this moment, the students below the stage started to cheer, leaving Kong Junxiang confused, thinking it was simply because he sang well.

But the next second, his shoulder was tapped.

Kong Junxiang instinctively turned his head.

The moment he saw Ding Xiang, he froze on the spot, completely dumbfounded.

Ding Xiang handed the fresh flowers to him and gave him a light hug.

Then, amidst the cheers and jeers of the numerous students, her face flushed red, she covered her face, smiled, and fled off the stage.

Only then did Kong Junxiang react.

He was struck by immense surprise and happiness, his face nearly splitting from smiling so wide.

Fortunately, Li Luo backstage was quite reliable. Before the main verse cut in, he deliberately gave a more forceful drumbeat cue, which made Kong Junxiang snap back to reality and quickly continue singing.

Perhaps due to the encouragement, Kong Junxiang sang with more abandon this time. It felt as if his entire chest had opened up, and his voice was no longer as tense as before.

After the song ended, the whole venue erupted in thunderous applause.

Kong Junxiang, with a satisfied expression, bowed slightly to the audience and then walked off the stage holding the flowers.

"Teacher Kong, congratulations, congratulations," Li Luo greeted Kong Junxiang with a chuckle.

"It's all thanks to your drum cue, otherwise I might have really messed up the song." Kong Junxiang patted Li Luo's shoulder, now completely in high spirits, a new man.

He was like a completely different person from the nervous wreck he had been backstage earlier.

"Teacher Ding is still waiting for you," Li Luo said with a grin. "Work harder, try to let us meet a little Kong before graduation."

"You little rascal." Kong Junxiang laughed and tapped him on the head, then scolded jokingly, "You're getting more and more out of line, huh? You'll say anything now."

"Doesn't that show how close we are as teacher and student?" Li Luo said shamelessly. "If you two get together in the future, just remember to give me a red envelope."

"Nothing's set in stone yet," Kong Junxiang waved his hands repeatedly. "Don't you go spreading this around."

"Don't worry, if any news gets out, it definitely won't be from me."

"That's true..." Kong Junxiang's lips twitched. He had great confidence in the gossip-spreading ability of the Class Eight students. "I'll head back then. Good luck with your performance later."

Li Luo gave Teacher Kong an okay gesture and then watched him walk towards the audience seating.

On his way back to his seat, Kong Junxiang looked down at the fresh flowers, which he hadn't examined closely before, and suddenly noticed something odd.

This bouquet of flowers... why did it look so plain?

It wasn't that he disliked it; after all, it was a gift from Ding Xiang, and he would be happy no matter how plain it was.

But it just felt strange... After all, Ding Xiang didn't know he would be on stage singing today. Logically, she couldn't have prepared fresh flowers in advance.

So this bouquet was prepared on the spot?

He had no idea where she got it from.

As he thought this, Kong Junxiang had already returned to the Class Eight seating area.

The moment he got back, he received a warm welcome from the Class Eight students.

Zhang Guohuang, like a monkey, cupped his mouth and let out strange howls, then shouted, "Teacher Kong, you sang great!"

Kong Junxiang laughingly pushed him back into his seat and then sat down beside Ding Xiang.

The two of them put their heads together and chatted, both with faces full of smiles.

Xu Yinghuan, sitting on Ding Xiang's other side, was grinning so hard from vicarious joy that her face was about to split.

By now, Yan Zhusheng had returned backstage and gave Li Luo a V-sign, "Mission accomplished."

Li Luo gave her a thumbs-up, "Comrade Yan Zhusheng, you did very well."

"So, does the organization have any rewards this time?" Yan Zhusheng asked with a serious face.

"What reward do you want?"

"Can you help me wash my hands?" Yan Zhusheng blinked, holding out her hands and saying honestly, "I was in a bit of a hurry just now, my hands are all muddy."

Li Luo glanced down and saw that Yan Zhusheng's hands were very dirty, with dirt still remaining under her fingernails.

This made Li Luo feel a little embarrassed. "Let's go, let's go, I'll take you to wash them."

After saying that, Li Luo notified Niu Qingling, then led Yan Zhusheng out of the basketball court to find the nearest restroom.

In front of the sinks, Yan Zhusheng looked at Li Luo, and Li Luo looked at Yan Zhusheng. They stared at each other.

"Go on, wash."

"Reward." Yan Zhusheng held out her hands.

Li Luo said, "...Why are you acting like a three-year-old?"

Pulling Yan Zhusheng's hands under the faucet, Li Luo turned on the water and carefully helped her clean off the mud, even thoroughly picking at her fingernails.

After he was done, Li Luo felt his pants pockets and realized he hadn't brought any tissues. He simply took Yan Zhusheng's hands and rubbed them a few times on his own school uniform to dry them.

"Alright, let's go," Li Luo said. "We still have to tune the instruments."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng followed Li Luo with a light spring in her step, and the two quickly returned backstage.

Niu Qingling, Shao Youpeng, Xie Shuchen, and Qian Siliang were already there, ready to go.

After Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng rejoined them, the six of them checked their respective instruments and microphones.

The No. 1 High School's bonfire party started at seven in the evening and would last until eight-thirty.

When the time reached eight-fifteen, the third-to-last act was about to end.

Ying Chanxi's figure appeared backstage, and she immediately spotted Li Luo, who was holding a guitar and chatting with Yan Zhusheng.

"Why are you here?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow, noticing Ying Chanxi's figure right away.

"To help out," Ying Chanxi tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear, pretending to speak casually. "I was assigned to come backstage at this time to do some backstage work."

"Class President, didn't you pick this time slot yourself?" The vice class president, Jian Zhenyuan, who had followed her, asked in confusion.

Ying Chanxi said, "...Why don't you go help over there first."

Sensing something was off with Ying Chanxi's tone, Jian Zhenyuan quickly slipped away.

Li Luo, on the other hand, looked at Ying Chanxi with a faint smile, "You're the vice president of the student council. Don't tell lies that are so easily exposed, alright?"

"You shut up," Ying Chanxi glared at him. "I just wanted to come see you guys, alright? Are you satisfied now?"

It was unknown whether Li Luo was satisfied.

But beside them, Xie Shuchen was quite moved. "Class President, you... I'm a bit embarrassed now. I was quite relaxed before, but now I'm getting nervous again."

"Ahem..." Ying Chanxi was made a bit awkward by his words, but she went along with what Xie Shuchen said, "Anyway, do your best, you all. I'll go get busy now."

Ying Chanxi ran off to coordinate with the members of the student council.

Meanwhile, Xu Youyu, after making a patrol lap outside, returned backstage and came over to Li Luo. "How are the preparations? They'll be calling you on stage soon."

"We're all set," Li Luo strummed the strings, then looked at Yan Zhusheng. "As long as a certain someone doesn't trip over the microphone cable and break it again."

"Don't worry." Xu Youyu glanced at him. "This time, we specially prepared a wireless microphone for Zhusheng. She can mess around with it however she wants."

"So thoughtful?"

"What thoughtful?" Xu Youyu said with a laugh. "Last time, it was Yan Zhusheng's family who paid for the microphone. Later, her mother simply added a bit more money and had the school get a new wireless one."

"The wired microphones are actually pretty good," Yan Zhusheng muttered in a low voice.

"Alright, good luck you guys." Xu Youyu cheered on the members of the rock club.

Beside them, Shao Youpeng's heart instantly soared, thinking that following Li Luo really paid off.

He had never seen Xu Youyu pay so much attention to the rock club before, but now he often saw Xu Youyu coming over to say hello.

Although most of the time, Xu Youyu was talking to Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng, it was still better than not seeing her at all before.

Especially after the arts and science streams were separated in the second year, with Shao Youpeng in Class One and Xu Youyu in Class Sixteen, it was really not easy to see her.

Now, it was only through Li Luo's connections in the rock club that Shao Youpeng could occasionally see Xu Youyu.

He could be considered to be benefiting from the association.

As for the threat from Li Luo?

This guy hangs out with Yan Zhusheng so much every day, how could he be a threat?

In Shao Youpeng's view, Xu Youyu had become familiar with Li Luo as a side effect of being good friends with Yan Zhusheng and Ying Chanxi.

"Next, let's welcome the six members of our rock club, who will present to us an original song by student Li Luo of Class Eight, Year One—"

"The Sky Has No Limit!"

On stage, the host had already announced the name of the next act.

The student council members backstage immediately sprang into action, helping Li Luo and the others move all the musical equipment onto the stage.

After a simple soundcheck and confirmation on stage, Niu Qingling scanned her surroundings, made eye contact with her bandmates to confirm, and then nodded lightly.

At the same time, behind the stage, under Xu Youyu's direction, a curtain was slowly raised.

The already prepared projector was turned on, and the lyrics of the new song "The Sky Has No Limit" were displayed on the curtain for the students to see.

In the audience, when everyone saw Yan Zhusheng's figure appear on stage, many people instantly became expectant.

At the sports meet over a month ago, everyone had already witnessed Yan Zhusheng's talent.

Now, seeing Yan Zhusheng perform live again, it wasn't just the boys; even some of the girls couldn't help but perk up their ears.

But the most exaggerated one was Zhang Guohuang.

Upon seeing Li Luo and the others on stage, he immediately jumped onto his chair and shouted, "Class President, I love you!"

Li Luo felt a wave of exasperation. He still waved at him, but he wished the kid would just quiet down.

But after Zhang Guohuang set a bad precedent, Xu Yinghuan couldn't help but shout towards the stage, "Yan Zhusheng! I love you!"

Yan Zhusheng, however, was very calm and waved in Xu Yinghuan's direction.

Then.

Niu Qingling was already seated at the drum set, raising her drumsticks.

Tsk, tsk, tsk.

Following three crisp sounds, with Niu Qingling setting the rhythm, Li Luo and the others instantly followed, and the music began.

The rock band, having practiced together countless times, operated perfectly under Niu Qingling's lead.

Yan Zhusheng closed her eyes, her lips slowly approaching the microphone.

The moment the music's rhythm entered the main verse, she opened her eyes in a flash, her gaze as clear as a mirror, having already entered a state of flow.

"When I was curiously tapping on the black and white keys"

"When I was hiding in my room, performing, lost in joy"

During the main verse, Yan Zhusheng's singing gradually drew the students into the song's atmosphere.

Until the chorus arrived—

"The sky has no limit!"

"My future is boundless"

As the lyrics of the chorus came out, Yan Zhusheng went full throttle, instantly making everyone's minds buzz and soar high into the sky, as if their souls had left their bodies.

(End of this chapter)
